semiconductor_relevance: Low — iRay Group's primary focus is on digital X-ray components and micro-display backplanes, which have limited direct application in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: iRay Group is a supplier of digital X-ray core components and silicon-based micro-display backplanes, primarily serving the medical imaging, industrial non-destructive testing, and security sectors. Their products include detectors, high-voltage generators, and X-ray tubes, as well as high-resolution micro-display backplanes for smart devices.
